sign-in.headline: Smart inventory for your restaurant
sign-in.description: Operations dashboard, demand forecast and alerts in one place.
sign-in.title: Sign in
sign-in.subtitle: Access your StockIA panel

sign-up.headline: Set up your restaurant in minutes
sign-up.description: Create your administrator account and start registering supplies, recipes and your team.
sign-up.title: Create account
sign-up.subtitle: Sign up for StockIA
sign-up.error: The account could not be created. Try again.

errors.no-session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.last-admin: The team must keep at least one Administrator.
errors.remove-self: You cannot remove your own account from the team.

profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Edit your account and restaurant details.
profile.password-hint: Leave it blank to keep your current password.
profile.error: The profile could not be saved. Try again.

team.title: Team and roles
team.description: Assign the Administrator or Employee role to each team member, invite new members or remove them.
team.temporary-password: The member is created with the temporary password {password}; a real API would send an invitation email.
team.invite-error: The member could not be invited. Try again.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Register, edit and delete your supplies. Quantities are discounted automatically when a dish linked by recipe is sold.
inventory.empty: You have not registered supplies yet. Create the first one with "New supply".

hints.min-threshold: At or below this quantity the supply shows as low stock.
hints.shelf-life: The expiration date is today plus the shelf life.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Link supplies to each dish so stock is discounted when it is sold. "Sell one" registers a real sale; if any supply is short, the sale is rejected and the stock does not change.
recipes.empty: You have not registered recipes yet.
recipes.sold-detail: The sale is in the sales history and its supplies were discounted.

errors.line: Choose a supply and a quantity greater than 0.
errors.incomplete: The recipe needs a dish name and at least one ingredient.

sales.title: Sales history
sales.description: History of confirmed and voided sales, the data the demand forecast learns from.
sales.empty: No sales yet. Use "Sell one" in Recipes to register the first one.
sales.void-confirm: Void the sale of {dishes}? Supplies already used are not returned to stock.

errors.recipe-not-found: The recipe to sell was not found.
errors.insufficient-stock: Not enough stock to sell "{dish}". Missing supplies: {items}.

forecast.title: Demand forecast
forecast.description: Projected sales per dish for the next 7 days, combining sales history and weather.
forecast.empty: No forecasts yet. Use the button above to generate the first one.
forecast.chart-label: Projected units for each of the next 7 days

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Low-stock, expiration and equipment-fault notifications sent by WhatsApp and email. Critical alerts must reach both channels.
alerts.pending: No pending alerts | {count} pending alert | {count} pending alerts
alerts.retry-on: Retry the delivery by {channel} of the alert {message}
alerts.acknowledged: The alert was marked as attended.

hints.critical-channels: Critical alerts are delivered by WhatsApp and email.

placeholders.message: e.g. Lettuce below the minimum stock

errors.not-delivered: The alert must be delivered on every required channel before it is marked as attended.

recommendations.title: Automatic recommendations
recommendations.description: Menu and purchase suggestions based on popularity and seasonality.

plans.title: Plans and subscription
plans.description: Pay or renew your subscription with Stripe or PayPal.
plans.simulated-note: Simulated payment: no real charges are processed.

dashboard.projected-demand: Projected demand (AI) for the next days
